title: Stellar Matrices
wikitext:
{{Stub|Information regarding the events of Legacy of the Lasting Night.}} {{Terminology Infobox |image = Stellar Matrix.png |nation = The Black Shores |type = Lore }} '''Stellar Matrices''' are, based on the computational protocols of the [[Black Shores]]' [[Tethys System]], a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. They have the capacity to store immense amounts of information and can even simulate a [[The Lament|Lament]].[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2#Stellar Matrix|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2, Stellar Matrix]] :''Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament.''

:''Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.'' :''The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.'' Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework. ==Overview== The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of [[Solaris-3]]. In the Black Shores, Stellar Matrices sit in [[Tethys' Deep]], where their code stretches across the vast underground sky like ever-shifting celestial bodies.[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2#Tethys' Deep|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2, Tethys' Deep]] :''Here sits the Black Shores' Lament observation hub, the heart of the Tethys System. Its code stretches across the vast underground sky like ever-shifting celestial bodies, known as the "Stellar Matrices."'' Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study, observe, and Modulate them.[[Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — The Black Shores#Modulation Device|Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — The Black Shores, Modulation Device]] :''At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has even been honored with the title of "The Modulator".'' However, as these celestial bodies collide, merge, and collapse, the code evolves through countless iterations. Occasionally, this process spawns errant code within some Stellar Matrices. To avoid contamination, the Black Shores contains these Stellar Matrices in special [[Tacetite]] vessels in the [[Error Cell]]. The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2#Error Cell|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2, Error Cell]] :''The Stellar Matrices' orbital dance represents the execution of complex, high-dimensional code. As these celestial bodies collide, merge, and collapse, the code evolves through countless iterations. Occasionally, this process spawns errant code within some Stellar Matrices. To avoid contamination, the Black Shores contains these Stellar Matrices in special Tacetite vessels.'' :''The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.'' ===[[Modulation Hall]]=== The Modulation Hall is where "[[Shorekeeper|Modulator]]" of the past and people of the present observe and guide the course of stars in the vast underground sky. Through here all beings are reborn as stars, which, in turn, reflect brief moments of reality. With the power of the Tethys System, Star Matrices brought to this place can reveal glimpses of the past, whether of destruction or renewal.[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2#Modulation Hall|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2, Modulation Hall]] :''The lighthouse of the subterranean galaxy and the heart of human activity in the Black Shores. It is where "Modulator" of the past and people of the present observe and guide the course of stars in the vast underground sky.'' :''Through here all beings are reborn as stars, which, in turn, reflect brief moments of reality. With the power of the Tethys System, Star Matrices brought to this place can reveal glimpses of the past, whether of destruction or renewal.'' ===[[Data Torrent]]=== The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and [[Waveworn Phenomenon|Waveworn]] back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament.[[Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2#Data Torrent|Wutherium Geographic: Lands and Waters — The Black Shores Vol. 2, Data Torrent]] :''The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament.'' ===Necrostar=== A Necrostar is a type of Stellar Matrix that swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Stellar Matrices find their end. Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it. A Necrostar marks the beginning and the end of destruction.[[Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — The Black Shores#Necrostar|Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians — The Black Shores, Necrostar]] :''Inside the Tethys System, a celestial body called Necrostar swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Matrices find their end.'' :''Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it.''

:''The Necrostar marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation... Or perhaps, merely a lie.'' Necrostars were once known as "black holes" in ancient astronomy. All of Solaris-3's data is converted into stars for observation by the Tethys System, while the discarded data is cast into the Necrostar.{{Quest|Legacy of the Lasting Night}} :'''''The Shorekeeper:''' This is the Necrostar, once known in ancient astronomy as a "black hole."'' :'''''The Shorekeeper:''' The Tethys System transforms data into stars, observing the entire Solaris, and discarded data are cast into the Necrostar.'' Due to its nature, Necrostar's frequencies are incredibly complex.{{Quest|Legacy of the Lasting Night}} :'''''The Shorekeeper:''' Just as it described, the Necrostar's frequency is indeed incredibly complex.'' ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Stellar Matrices |1_zhs = |1_zht = |1_ja = |1_ko = |1_es = |1_fr = |1_de = |1_th = |1_pt = |2_en = Stellar Matrix |2_zhs = |2_zht = |2_ja = |2_ko = |2_es = |2_fr = |2_de = |2_th = |2_pt = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.3}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{Lore Navbox|Terminology}}
